scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF parity plan with current primary-source evidence about version-specific writer maturity, application consumer routes, and ACIS carrier loss, without running peers or changing implementation behavior.

method.kind: Public primary-source documentation, source-entry-point, release-matrix, and issue-report audit
method.evidenceBoundary: Public project documentation and a reporter-provided generated reproducer establish route descriptions and test leads, not results reproduced here. Mutable branch documentation is not pinned to a binary. No local defect or semantic support promotion was established.

observed: The project README distinguishes reader claims from writer claims and says advanced R2010+ reader objects may be skipped.
The README reports CRC problems for R2010-R2018 writes, while the build switch and dxf2dwg utility describe writing through R2000 only.
Aggregate coverage numbers and broad read-version statements are not per-version native acceptance receipts.
evidence.planUse: Admit exact pinned peer routes by operation and emitted AC code. Do not infer writer coverage from read coverage or headline percentages.

observed: The public compatibility table lists DWG writing by AC version and excludes AC1021.
A 2025 maintainer response says old AC1014/AC1015 output may require recovery, AC1021 writer work had not been implemented at that time, and AC1018/AC1027/AC1032 were then the better routes to test.
The issue is historical; later releases may differ, and no exact current release binary was run.
evidence.planUse: Pin the peer artifact and repeat the generated control per version. Require independent reopen/audit and capture recovery/repair outcomes; self-readback is not independent acceptance.

observed: LibreCAD_3 documents optional DWG import and a deliberate no-DWG-write policy pending promoted claims, independent evidence, and project approval.
FreeCAD documents that DWG import/export is mediated by external converters and a selected DXF importer; its current source implements converter selection and conversion to DXF.
FreeCAD's DXF importer backend and preferences affect what the consumer can create from a DXF.
evidence.planUse: Keep LibreCAD_3 DWG compatibility read-only. Separate direct libdxfrw DXF acceptance from converter-mediated FreeCAD DWG workflow, and identify every stage and effective setting.

observed: ezdxf documents SAT/SAB carrier tooling but a limited supported ACIS entity set and polygonal-mesh-oriented projection.
LibreDWG issue #1411 reports a reproducible source-created AC1032 SAB carrier disappearing in an R2013+ ACDSDATA conversion route while the REGION record survives.
The issue's generator and inspector both use ezdxf, and the conversion was not reproduced in this review; it is transport-loss evidence to validate, not independent shape semantics.
evidence.planUse: Keep generated SAB transport checks separate from body association, ACIS parsing, analytic B-rep correctness, and native consumer acceptance. Keep generated drawings disposable.

nextActions: Continue local generated, version-scoped writer and AcDs body-state slices with focused fast tests.
At the planned composed checkpoint, pin peer revisions/binaries and test each exact read/write/version route separately.
Capture output AC code, integrity diagnostics, recovery or repair state, object/payload inventories, consumer route, warnings, and process status.
Keep LibreCAD_3 DWG qualification read-only and FreeCAD direct-DXF and converter-mediated workflows separate.
Keep all six external-only J items DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
